samples.brief: Design how the scheduler should recover a queue after a crash and write the plan down.
Investigate why the nightly export sometimes produces an empty file; the cause is unknown.
Plan the migration of the user store to a new database with no downtime.
Find out why memory use grows during long sessions and propose a fix.
Restyle the settings page so the form fields line up on narrow screens.
Build a reusable date picker component for the web dashboard.
Fix the layout of the pricing table that overflows on tablets.
Add a dark color theme to the admin web interface.
Generate a set of product images for the catalog from the written descriptions.
Read the full archive of meeting transcripts at once and summarize every decision.
Create illustration images for each chapter of the handbook.
Turn the hand-drawn wireframe sketches into finished banner images.
Rename the helper get_user to load_user in every file of the repository.
Run the formatter over the whole codebase and commit the mechanical changes.
Replace the old logging call with the new logger API across all two hundred modules.
Update the license header comment in every source file to the new wording.
Fix the typo recieve to receive in the README.
Bump the linter version from 1.7.11 to 1.7.12 in the tool pin file.
Change the default timeout in the config file from 30 to 60 seconds.
Correct the wrong year in the copyright footer string.
Implement the CSV export endpoint exactly as the attached plan describes; done when the three listed tests pass.
Add retry with backoff to the upload client following the written spec, with the acceptance criteria in the ticket.
Implement pagination for the orders API as specified: page and limit parameters, a next link, and tests for both edges.
Add a new product category page to the Example Shop website.
Fix the scoring bug in the Example Arena game where ties count as losses.
Rename the checkout labels across every page of the Example Shop website.
Design the next season of levels for the Example Arena game.
Answer a question from the team about how the release calendar works.
Tidy up the notes folder for the quarterly review.
Write a short welcome message for a new contributor.
